title: Heal annotation entropy during on-prem upgrades and ship telemetry-driven hotpatch
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Several Private/VPC customer escalations after the 2026.02 on-prem helm rollout showed tenant controllers skipping reconciles due to unexpected/misaligned resource annotations. The operator reconciliation loop uses annotation fingerprints to detect managed resources; a template change in helm values resulted in transient annotation key churn for some tenants which caused the controller to treat resources as immutable and skip KV cache schema upgrades. This ticket coordinates a minimal production hotpatch to heal affected clusters, a non-disruptive backfill reconciler, and telemetry improvements so future annotation entropy is detectable and automatable.
acceptance_criteria: Affected tenant clusters recover to normal reconcile cadence without rolling upgrades or tenant data migration
Automated backfill reconciler marks stale annotation keys and triggers idempotent reconcile; verified on 3 staging clusters
New telemetry emits annotation-entropy metric and per-tenant anomaly alerts to PagerDuty runbooks
A small, reversible helm release (operator-2026.03.1-hotfix) deployed to affected customers with documented rollback steps
steps_taken: 2026-03-05: Triage call with support, infra, and SEs to correlate customer reports — found common pattern: operator skipping reconcile after helm value change
2026-03-06: Reproduced locally by applying helm chart with annotation key rename; operator logs show skip path where managed-fingerprint mismatch leads to no-op
2026-03-07: Created diagnostic playbook and a kubejob to list tenants with 'annotation-fingerprint-mismatch' in operator logs
2026-03-09: Implemented a conservative backfill controller that checks for known legacy annotation keys and atomically writes expected keys if safe
2026-03-10: Built hotpatch image and ran blue-green canary on two internal staging clusters; validated zero downtime and reconcile recovery
2026-03-12: Prepared helm chart patch and rollback commands; drafted customer communication template and runbook for SEs
next_steps: 2026-03-15: Coordinate targeted rollout to 6 affected customers during maintenance window (SE-led) and monitor reconcile rates
Add end-to-end test to CI that simulates annotation churn and ensures operator backfill path is exercised
Merge telemetry PR to emit 'operator.annotation_entropy' and wire to existing anomaly detection dashboard
Postmortem: write RCA and prevention checklist; propose preflight helm validator that rejects annotation-key renames without a migration plan
comments: 2026-03-06 - Ava Martinez: Initial triage - SEs reported 7 customers with reconcile stalls after 2026.02 helm deploys. Correlated to chart changes that included new annotation keys.
2026-03-07 - Rohit Kapoor: Repro attached in PR; the operator compareFingerprint() returned mismatch due to order/extra keys. Started a small backfill controller to be safe.
2026-03-09 - Mei Chen (SRE): Telemetry gap observed - only error logs existed. Added temporary log marker 'ANNOTATION_ENTROPY_DETECTED' for quicker incident correlation.
2026-03-11 - Priya Desai (Support): Drafted customer-facing note. Customers with Dedicated capacity requested explicit maintenance windows; will coordinate with account owners.

2026-03-13 - Engineering Review: Engineering leads approved hotpatch path with a canary traffic pattern. Agreed to a two-hour maintenance window per tenant and immediate rollback if KV schema read error rates increase.
2026-03-15 - Rohit Kapoor: Canary started on staging-3 at 09:40UTC. Reconcile rates returned to baseline within 6 minutes. Rolling out to first production tenant at 13:00UTC after SE confirmation.
